data.name: Divyarun
data.gender_notes: Divyarun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Dawwar' meaning 'to light up'. Divyarun is a name evoking the image of a shining, radiant light. The name Divyarun carries the meaning “Radiant light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Divyarun usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to those who are a beacon of light in the world, guiding others towards the path of righteousness and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Divyarun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Divyarun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
